title: Chocolate Mud Cake
description: A rich and deeply chocolatey mud cake with a dense, fudgy crumb, topped with a silky milk and dark chocolate ganache — a classic crowd-pleaser from taste.com.au.

method.instruction: Preheat oven to 160°C. Grease a deep 23 cm springform cake pan and line with baking paper.

Place the chocolate, butter, coffee and milk in a heatproof bowl set over a pan of barely simmering water (don't let the bowl touch the water) and stir until smooth and melted. Remove from the heat and set aside to cool completely.
Sift flour and cocoa into a large bowl. Add sugar and stir to combine. Make a well in the centre.
Add the cooled chocolate mixture, eggs, vanilla and sour cream to the well. Stir until smooth and fully combined.
Pour batter into the prepared pan and bake for 1 hour, or until a skewer inserted into the centre comes out with moist crumbs.
Cool in pan for 20 min, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.

Place milk chocolate, dark chocolate, cream and butter in a heatproof bowl over a pan of barely simmering water. Stir until melted and smooth. Remove from heat and set aside to cool until thickened to a spreadable consistency.
Spread ganache over the top and sides of the cooled cake. Refrigerate until set.

notes.title: Source
